tn_deep_creek.name: Deep Creek
tn_deep_creek.note: Only ClimbingAway (Jan-Nov, effectively all year); no second month-naming source; MP chart unreadable.

ca_echo_cove.name: Echo Cove
ca_echo_cove.note: Joshua Tree-wide: guide names Oct-Apr; SummitPost early/mid Oct to late Apr/early May, ideal late Oct-early Dec and Mar-Apr; summer too hot. Echo Cove takes the park's season (south side sunny for winter).

ct_eastern_coastal_slope.name: Eastern Coastal Slope
ct_eastern_coastal_slope.note: Nothing specific to this region; only anecdotal forum posts about Ragged Mountain (Nov/Dec prime); no month-naming source.

nc_pilot_mountain.name: Pilot Mountain
nc_pilot_mountain.note: Sources say only spring and fall (one 'spring through fall'); season words, no months.

nh_humphrey_s_ledge_2.name: Humphrey's Ledge
nh_humphrey_s_ledge_2.note: North Conway-wide: Whitehorse guide says April-October (Sep-Oct best); a trip listing says late April-late November; took shared window Apr-Oct. Winter use is ice (Black Pudding Gully), not rock.

ok_quartz_mountain.name: Quartz Mountain
ok_quartz_mountain.note: Travel guide names Oct-Apr; SummitPost 'mid fall to mid spring'; MP calls it a winter spot; south-facing so summer unbearable; Wikipedia spring/fall best; climber gatherings early Apr and early Nov.

wy_lower_canyon_granite.name: Lower Canyon Granite
wy_lower_canyon_granite.note: MP text: spring and fall nicer days, comfy most days in summer; season words only, no months, no second source.

ca_bowman_valley.name: Bowman Valley
ca_bowman_valley.note: Words only: Emeralds best spring and fall; Bowman Lake road snowbound into early May. No months named.

ca_mount_st_helena.name: Mount St. Helena
ca_mount_st_helena.note: Only hiking sources found (Mar-May, fall); no climbing season source.

pa_safe_harbor_south.name: Safe Harbor South
pa_safe_harbor_south.note: Spring and fall, cool-weather crag, avoid summer and winter; season words only, no months.

az_isolation_canyon.name: Isolation Canyon
az_isolation_canyon.note: Only forum anecdotes (south-facing full sun, climbed in December); no month-naming source.

nc_main_climbing_areas.name: Main Climbing Areas
nc_main_climbing_areas.note: Crowders Mountain: guidebook listing 'Best Fall to Spring', other guide spring and fall; season words only.

nm_aguirre_bouldering.name: Aguirre Bouldering
nm_aguirre_bouldering.note: No season source for this boulder area; campground pages only.

ca_williamson_rock.name: Williamson Rock
ca_williamson_rock.note: Closed to climbing (frog habitat; current status unverified). rockclimbing.com says Mar-Oct at 6,700 ft; proposed reopening permit window Aug 1-Nov 15. No agreed season.

co_mother_s_buttress.name: Mother's Buttress
co_mother_s_buttress.note: Unaweep-wide: guide service early Mar-mid Jun and mid Sep-late Nov; SummitPost March into December; Visit Grand Junction spring and fall best. Took the guide's windows.

md_carderock.name: Carderock
md_carderock.note: Spring/fall better than hot humid summer; cold sunny afternoons good; season words only.

nm_utopian_vistas.name: Utopian Vistas
nm_utopian_vistas.note: No source for this crag; Tres Piedras region listed spring/fall/winter, raptor nesting mid-Feb to late May.

nm_tres_piedras.name: Tres Piedras
nm_tres_piedras.note: SummitPost lists spring, fall, winter (words only); raptor nesting restrictions mid-Feb to late May. No months.

ok_charon_s_gardens.name: Charon's Gardens
ok_charon_s_gardens.note: SummitPost: late fall to early spring (other pages say spring/fall); summer hot with ticks. Words only, no months.

sd_mohican_the.name: Mohican, The
sd_mohican_the.note: Spearfish Canyon: spring-fall (RopeWiki), late spring-early fall, 'nearly year-round'; no months named and sources loose.
